description: This Java class 'OrderContext' encapsulates contextual information related to ordering in the OpenMRS system, such as order type, care setting, and custom attributes. It provides methods to get, set, and manage these contextual attributes.

classes.name: OrderContext
classes.description: A class that holds contextual information such as order type, care setting, and custom attributes for processing orders within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getOrderType
methods.description: Returns the current OrderType associated with this context.

methods.name: setOrderType
methods.description: Sets the OrderType for this context.

methods.name: getCareSetting
methods.description: Returns the CareSetting associated with this context.

methods.name: setCareSetting
methods.description: Sets the CareSetting for this context.

methods.name: getContextAttributes
methods.description: Returns the map of context attributes, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setContextAttributes
methods.description: Overrides the entire context attributes map.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified attribute from the context.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Adds or updates a specific attribute in the context.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute from the context by name.
